purpose: Check laterality and named rib numbers.
Distinguish the sixth rib from one fracture site.

text: 病历一记载疑似第六肋骨骨折；复查报告记载未见骨折。
purpose: Preserve uncertainty and contradictory negative evidence.

text: 资料记载排除第六肋骨骨折。
purpose: Keep explicit exclusion distinct from a confirmed fracture.

text: 左侧胸部疼痛，未提供影像检查或明确诊断。
purpose: Avoid inferring a diagnosis from pain alone.
